name: vllm_lb_v18 (common KV reservation 0.85)
selection: The unchanged E14 eligible items by frozen manifest order, 24/24/11; no new answer-based selection. Controls use first four indices per bin. No truncation.
stopping: Native DiffusionGemma generation config unchanged; per-request seeds unsupported. Engine seeds match across arms in a block but do not establish trajectory pairing.
timing: One warm-up per eligible item and engine; request boundary sync only; CPU scheduler phase counts; reject timed graph captures or backend/inductor compilations. W includes prefill, S begins at final prefill scheduler completion and includes canvas commits. N counts denoising forwards only.
inference: Batch 1 single-engine offline native vLLM serving, HTTP/network excluded. Adapter arms PIECEWISE, dense official default graph mode. No per-step profiling events.
statistics: Item x repeat label paired geometric means, item-clustered 95% bootstrap CIs; repeat is not a matched random trajectory. Accuracy counts and clustered accuracy differences; McNemar descriptive/exploratory only.
memory_preflight: Longest eligible input, every arm, same 0.85 settings. V18 0.92 failed main warmup OOM at 96K; this new protocol lowers KV reservation equally for all four arms. Method state caps and native decoding unchanged. A further change requires a new spec.
scoring: Unchanged v15-lbv2-nemo-mcq-default-on-final-channel-1; decode token ids with special tokens preserved privately. Strict correctness requires EOS.
publication: No prompts, prompt hashes, raw outputs, answers or private binding paths. Frozen input/source hashes only in private binding. Public item indices are manifest ordinal labels.
gpu_accounting: Terminal receipt records whole worker reserved wall seconds, including loading, warmup and failures; per-request wall seconds reported separately.
